title: The gate test:file:gates exits 1 in the cloud container because its default browser hangs on every page.
expected: The gate exits 0 on a clean tree (docs/QUALITY-GATE.md; web/package.json script test:file:gates).
actual: Exit 1 in 5 of 5 tries; the page check times out. With CHROME_PATH set to the installed headless shell and CI=true the same gate exits 0 with 134 PASS (baseline row 8b).
suggested_change: none: the cause is the container's browser wrapper; check the gate once on the work PC

title: AGENTS.md names tests/nightly-known-failures.txt, which does not exist; the file is tests/known-failures.txt.
expected: The rules file names the known-failures file that the weekly job reads (.github/workflows/weekly-tests.yml uses tests/known-failures.txt).
actual: AGENTS.md says a weekly failure 'not in tests/nightly-known-failures.txt is new'; that file is absent.
suggested_change: Change the file name in AGENTS.md to tests/known-failures.txt.

screen: /start, synthetic run following docs/react-workflow.md 'Open the interface'
title: Following the documented manual synthetic run in docs/react-workflow.md ends Failed at Legal & covenants; the run completes only if the credit agreement is also uploaded and chosen as the executed agreement, which the document does not say.
expected: docs/react-workflow.md:108-118 is a complete recipe for one synthetic run to a published report.
actual: 3 of 3 runs that followed the text exactly failed at Legal & covenants with 'No executed governing document'; web/scripts/connected-proof.mjs uploads proof/northbridge-credit-agreement.txt and chooses it, and that run completes.
probe: npm --prefix web run proof:connected (passes with the agreement); the failing path is the text of docs/react-workflow.md:110-118 followed by hand
suggested_change: Add the upload of proof/northbridge-credit-agreement.txt and the choice of it as the executed agreement to docs/react-workflow.md 'Open the interface'.

title: The run root is limited to 80 characters; a longer path is refused at start.
expected: A root path the analyst chooses works, or the limit and its reason are stated where the root is chosen.
actual: src/deploy_workflow/inbox/layout.py:61 raises 'root ... is N characters; use a shorter path (at most 80)'.
suggested_change: none: a deliberate guard with a clear message; record it in the work-PC prompt

title: The service serves routes the connected client never calls: GET /connected/reports, GET /api/runs/<id>, GET /activity.js, /data.js, /assets/*, /THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, /index.html and /library/index.html.
expected: Every served route has a caller, or is kept for a named reason (api-map.md).
actual: No caller in the connected client for these routes (api-map.md:39-79); some serve the legacy pages kept under ruling L1.
suggested_change: Stage 6: remove each route that has no caller and no named reason; keep those the legacy pages need while ruling L1 stands.

title: The legacy issuer library and the legacy run-start form ship in the release ZIP and stay reachable at /library/*, outside the two audited surfaces.
expected: The release holds the two surfaces the README names, or the owner keeps the legacy pages for a stated reason (ruling L1).
actual: apps/issuer-library is built to <workspace>/library/index.html and served at /library/*; docs/templates/context-form.html ships (surface-map.md).
suggested_change: none: the owner decides whether the legacy pages stay in the release

title: The scheduler posts run cards to a Teams webhook when CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_WEBHOOK and CREDIT_OS_TEAMS_LINK are set, a request to another host that README ruling R8 does not list as an exception; proof.serve does not clear the two variables.
expected: README ruling R8: the application works entirely offline, with CP-DR's lookups during a live run as the one recorded exception. docs/rulings/2026-11-16-teams-run-cards.md records Teams as a second exception, as one session's reading of the owner's answer.
actual: src/deploy_workflow/inbox/teams.py:182-197 posts with urllib when both variables are set; proof/serve.py:22-32 clears provider keys but not the Teams variables, so a synthetic run can post a card for a synthetic run.
suggested_change: none: the owner confirms or withdraws the Teams exception to R8, and says whether proof.serve clears the two variables
